_doc: Per-card fixes for scripts/goldfish.py. Keys are Oracle names; each entry replaces only the fields it names. Fields and effect strings are documented in docs/GOLDFISH.md. Add a 'note' saying why.

Leyline Immersion.note: the enchanted legendary creature taps for five; modeled as a 5-mana source usable from your next turn

Sylvan Library.note: draw two; keeps one extra card for 4 life while that stays at or above the life floor (20), puts the rest back (best on top)

Mystic Remora.note: draws off opponents' noncreature spells (fixed ~opp approximation); cumulative upkeep handled generically (kept 3 upkeeps)

Fact or Fiction.note: an opponent splits the five; modeled as keeping the best two

Meren of Clan Nel Toth.note: end step: return a creature card to hand (no experience counters, since creatures dying isn't modeled); experience-based reanimation to the battlefield not modeled
